bodies.heading: Regulatory coordination and life support, handled
bodies.lede: We manage the government-facing side of complex programs — regulatory coordination, permits and approvals — alongside manpower consulting and integrated life support services. This lets Tier One primes and international partners operate in the Kingdom without carrying the administrative and logistical overhead themselves.
